name: logika
description: Classical formal logic from G. Chelpanov's textbook: concepts, judgments, syllogisms, induction, fallacies, laws of thought. Two text modes — logical review (logika:review, analysis-only report) and argument fixing (rewrite with corrected logic) — plus solving logic textbook problems and checking causal-link justifications (rule of the third element). Russian-language references distilled from the source book.
